requirements.description: The fellowship must involve international physical mobility: the recruited researcher moves from one country to another to acquire new knowledge, skills and competences and develop their research career.
Applications must be made jointly by the researcher and a beneficiary in the academic or non-academic sector.

Duration: European Postdoctoral Fellowships last 12-24 months. Global Postdoctoral Fellowships have an outgoing phase of 12-24 months in a non-associated Third Country plus a mandatory 12-month return phase to a host in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country.

A Career Development Plan must be established jointly by the supervisor(s) and the researcher (comprising research objectives and training/career needs) and submitted as a project deliverable at the beginning of the action.

Training activities must integrate key transferable skills and competences (including digital ones, e.g. generative AI) and foster the culture of Open Science, knowledge valorisation, and (when applicable) innovation and entrepreneurship, as well as research integrity.

Secondments are optional within the fellowship duration in any country worldwide. For EF, secondments cannot exceed half of the requested duration; for GF, up to half of the outgoing phase. Secondments cannot take place during the mandatory 12-month return period.

An optional non-academic placement of up to 6 months at the end of the project is permitted at a non-academic organisation in an EU Member State or Associated Country; the request must be an integral part of the proposal and is subject to evaluation.
Open science practices must be implemented as an integral part of the methodology; a Data Management Plan (DMP) is a deliverable due by month 6 (FAIR data).

Part B-1 (Sections 1 Excellence, 2 Impact, 3 Implementation) must not exceed 10 pages, including all tables, figures and references. A Gantt chart (WPs, major deliverables, milestones, secondments/placements) must be included and counts towards the 10-page limit; it shows months elapsed, not dates.

The proposal must address the four Excellence aspects (research/innovation objectives and ambition; methodology incl. interdisciplinarity, gender dimension and open science; supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge; researcher's professional experience), the three Impact aspects (career/employability measures; dissemination, exploitation and communication plan; magnitude and importance of impacts), and the two Implementation aspects (work plan, risks and effort; host capacity and hosting arrangements).
